description:
Get a one-call snapshot of a US public company from SEC EDGAR: profile, most recent filings with links, and key financials (revenue, net income, EPS, assets, cash, operating cash flow) for the last two fiscal years and the latest quarter.

$0.006 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

filings.description: How many recent filings to list (default 8).

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. "AAPL". Give this or cik.

name: company_snapshot
title: Company snapshot
